title: Maximum Alternating Subarray Sum
summary: An alternating subarray is a sequence of elements in an array where the sum is calculated by adding and subtracting consecutive elements.
statement: An alternating subarray is a sequence of elements in an array where the sum is calculated by adding and subtracting consecutive elements. Given an array, find the maximum sum of any such subarray.
constraints: nums is a nonempty integer list of length up to 100000.
For a contiguous subarray, add its first value, subtract its second, and continue alternating signs.
Return the maximum alternating sum over all nonempty subarrays.
reference_solution:
def maximum_alternating_subarray_sum(nums):
    plus=nums[0];minus=float('-inf');answer=plus
    for value in nums[1:]:
        next_plus=max(value,minus+value)
        next_minus=plus-value
        plus,minus=next_plus,next_minus
        answer=max(answer,plus,minus)
    return answer
